Order:

{Per the Hon'ble Sri Justice A.Abhishek Reddy} Mr. Gandasiri Nagaraju, the friend of the detenu viz., Shivan Kanjiramathadathil Krishnan @ Shivan, has filed the present Writ Petition challenging the detention order vide No.110/PD- CELL/CCRB/RCKD/2022, dated 19.07.2022, passed by the respondent No.2 - Commissioner of Police-cum- Additional District Magistrate, Rachakonda Commissionerate, whereby, the detenu was detained under Section 3(2) of the Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Bootleggers, Dacoits, Drug-Offenders, Goondas, Immoral Traffic Offenders, Land Grabbers, Spurious Seed Offenders, Insecticide Offenders, Fertiliser Offenders, Food Adulteration Offenders, Fake Document Offenders, Scheduled Commodities Offenders, Forest Offenders, Gaming Offenders, Sexual Offenders, Explosive Substances Offenders,
Arms Offenders, Cyber Crime Offenders and White Collar or Financial Offenders Act, 1986 (in short,
'the AAR, J & JS,J PD Act'), and the consequential orders passed by the respondent No.1.
2.

sentences.text:
detention orders passed against Accused Nos.2, 3, 4, 6 and 8 in the subject crime i.e., Crime No.1082 of 2021 of Vanasthalipuram Police Station were already set aside by this Court vide orders passed in W.P.Nos.32044, 30693, 30692, 32015 and 16601 of 2022, dated 18.10.2022, 20.09.2022,
20.09.2022, 18.10.2022 and 06.07.2022 respectively.

Moreover, the impugned detention order was passed without adhering to the requirements/mandate given under Section 3(2) of the PD Act and by relying only on one crime registered for the offence punishable under Section 20(b)(ii)(C) of the NDPS Act, which does not add up to "disturbing the public order" and which is only a "law and order" problem.

Under these circumstances and since the facts and circumstances of the present case are akin to the facts and circumstances AAR, J & JS,J W.P.Nos.32044, 30693, 30692, 32015 and 16601 of 2022, the impugned orders are liable to be set aside.
6. In the result, the Writ Petition is allowed.
The impugned detention order vide No.110/PD-CELL/CCRB/RCKD/2022, dated 19.07.2022, passed by the respondent No.2, and the consequential orders passed by the respondent No.1, are hereby set aside.
The respondents are directed to set the detenu, namely, Shivan Kanjiramathadathil Krishnan @ Shivan S/o. Krishnan, at liberty forthwith, in case he is no longer required in any other criminal case.
The Miscellaneous Petitions, if any, pending in this Writ Petition shall stand closed.
There shall be no order as to costs.
